description.purpose: Renders the brief of one object row, pure and deterministic: `<type>: <main name>`, the filled slots in a fixed order (`who` as `<n> people`, never a name or reference), every fact handed in, each whole. No length and no count of its own (GH #1085): a request that names a window (context `input_soft`, alias `recall_input_soft`) gets the brief cut to a tenth of it with the mark `...[cut: <shown> of <total> chars shown; budget of the window]`; without one the brief is whole.
description.use_when: Inside an objects hive only, asked on `brief_render` by `./push` and `./tools`.
description.not_in_scope: No store, no clock, no round decision: whoever asks has decided who may read the brief.
description.emits_meaning: `rendered` with the text and the asker's `carry`, `reply_cell` mirrored.
description.consumes_meaning: A row and the facts about it.
